exit.note: beyond f_max, the exit depends on borrowers repaying / on rates rising

decision.sentence: Curator view (whole vault, all depositors): EXIT means pulling the vault's money out of its markets, STAY means keeping the allocation. STAY — exiting would avoid $1 of expected loss over the horizon, but would cost $84. Exit if you put the risk "Morpho Blue protocol exploit" above 2.7% (our estimate: 0.01%, i.e. ≈ once every 333 years). (Exiting would save less than $100: the two options are equivalent, no action needed.)
